summary:
Complete Postman Collection v2.1 for the Quiz Platform API.
Includes 13 folders and over 35 endpoints covering Categories, Exams, Subjects, Topics, Quizzes, Questions & Options, Candidate Attempts, Offline Synchronization, Bookmarks & Saved Quizzes, Authentication & Devices, Payments & Access, Analytics & Leaderboards, and Hostinger MySQL Diagnostics. Pre-configured with variables for baseUrl, authToken, categoryId, examId, quizId, questionId, and attemptId.
